name: Gate of the Valley
line: The Valley Gate was a gate in Jerusalem's broken wall, where Nehemiah left and returned on his night trip to inspect the ruins before rebuilding began.

moments.title: Out the Valley Gate at night
moments.text: Nehemiah went out through the Valley Gate in the dark with a few men. He inspected the walls that were broken down and the gates that fire had destroyed.

moments.title: Back through the Valley Gate
moments.text: After going up the valley by night and inspecting the wall, Nehemiah headed back and came into the city again through the Valley Gate. The officials did not know where he had gone.
